svg.title: Evergreen v0.8 real failing run receipt: what the agent reported vs. what changed in the 8 databases
svg.desc: Real v0.8 failing run receipt picked by a fixed rule (Workflow 06 household coverage review, claude-sonnet-5-5, trial 1, realistic seed). The agent reported that it reviewed both Thompsons, escalated David's file to a licensed producer, and set out the facts. Across the 32 SQLite tables in the 8 systems, AMS Escalations gained 2 rows, while AMS Tasks gained 0 rows, Comparative Rater gained 0 quotes, and Messaging Hub gained 0 messages. Missing the E&O duty to open a tracked producer task sets the score to 0.00.
